abstract: Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting from $35 a month for one site, with no renewal jump and no phone support. The first month is free for new customers until 1 December 2026.

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting. It runs the server, security, backups and support, and you manage the site in its MyKinsta dashboard. Its managed plans are for WordPress.
No. Kinsta is managed WordPress hosting. WP Umbrella says every site runs in its own container, with no shared IP pools, which is different from shared hosting.

The entry plan is $35 a month for one WordPress site, 10 GB of storage and about 35,000 visits. WP 2 is $70 for two sites. Larger Single plans run from $50 to $375 a month. Annual billing saves about two months.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta cost more at renewal?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. After the first month free and 3 months at half price, the entry plan renews at $35, the same list price. There is no first-term discount that expires.

The price pays for management, support and included tools, not raw hardware. WPThinker compares its $35 plan (1 site, 10 GB) with a $14 Cloudways server (25 GB, many sites). EXPERTE ranked its entry plan second most expensive of 14 hosts.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta have a free month or a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: New customers get the first month free on select plans until 1 December 2026. Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee that starts after the free period.
Yes on the right plan. WPThinker says Kinsta does not recommend the cheapest Single plan for stores and points to Single 65k at $50 or larger.
Yes in independent tests. EXPERTE measured a 0.232 s time to first byte, 3rd of 14 hosts, and Webhostingcat measured 77 ms. Hostingstep found WP Engine and Cloudways slightly faster on one run.
No. Kinsta lists 24/7 human support in 8 languages by chat. There is no phone line.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta include email or a domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Kinsta does not list email hosting or domain registration. You buy those elsewhere.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta host my FTP files?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinsta gives you SFTP and SSH access to your site files, according to reviewers, and it migrates your existing site for free. Check Kinsta's documents for the access details of your plan.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta support Drupal or Magento hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinsta's managed hosting plans are for WordPress only, according to CuratorBits. WPThinker notes that Kinsta sells separate application and database hosting. Check Kinsta's documents for other platforms.
Kinsta costs more and manages more. Cloudways costs less and gives more server control. Both have no renewal jump and no phone support. Compare them at your own traffic.
